package e2e

// 一人一盟（方案 §2.5、§5“一人一盟的两步”）：守卫与联盟分属两个实例时，同一玩家并发入会 / 被两个联盟批准，只有一个成功；
// kill -9 守卫方或联盟方之后，按同一 RequestID 重发、期限到守卫方 Settle、effect 重投收尾，不出现一人两盟，也不出现
// 永不释放的预约。

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/servicerpc"

	rpcalliance "example.com/planet/internal/rpc/alliance"
)

// pair 是两个实例上各一个联盟：a 在 3000，b 在 3001。
type pair struct{ a, b int64 }

func (s *suite) foundPair(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, leader *int64, open bool) pair {
	t := s.t
	var p pair
	for tries := 0; p.a == 0 || p.b == 0; tries++ {
		if tries > 100 {
			t.Fatal("Found never landed on both instances")
		}
		*leader++
		var reply rpcalliance.Reply
		err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			var err error
			reply, err = client.Found(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("found-%d", *leader), *leader, 1000, fmt.Sprintf("e2e-%d", *leader), open)
			return err
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		switch {
		case reply.ServedBySID == 3000 && p.a == 0:
			p.a = reply.Alliance.AllianceID
		case reply.ServedBySID == 3001 && p.b == 0:
			p.b = reply.Alliance.AllianceID
		}
	}
	return p
}

// checkOneAlliance：每个玩家至多在一个联盟的成员表里，守卫记的就是那个联盟，且最终没有未决预约。返回各联盟的人数。
func (s *suite) checkOneAlliance(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, alliances []int64, players []int64, settle time.Duration) map[int64]int {
	t := s.t
	var lastDetail string
	deadline := time.Now().Add(settle)
	for {
		in := map[int64][]int64{}
		sizes := map[int64]int{}
		for _, id := range alliances {
			var info rpcalliance.Reply
			err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
				var err error
				info, err = client.Info(ctx, target(t, id))
				return err
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("info %d: %v", id, err)
			}
			sizes[id] = len(info.Alliance.Members)
			for player := range members(info.Alliance) {
				in[player] = append(in[player], id)
			}
		}
		pending := 0
		for _, player := range players {
			if len(in[player]) > 1 {
				t.Fatalf("ONE-ALLIANCE VIOLATED: player %d is a member of %v", player, in[player])
			}
			var g rpcalliance.GuardReply
			err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
				var err error
				g, err = client.Guard(ctx, guard(t, player))
				return err
			})
			if err != nil && servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
				t.Fatalf("guard %d: %v", player, err)
			}
			want := int64(0)
			if len(in[player]) == 1 {
				want = in[player][0]
			}
			if g.State.PendingRequestID != "" {
				pending++
				lastDetail = fmt.Sprintf("player %d guard %+v", player, g.State)
				continue
			}
			if g.State.AllianceID != want {
				t.Fatalf("player %d: guard says alliance %d, membership says %v", player, g.State.AllianceID, in[player])
			}
		}
		if pending == 0 {
			return sizes
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("RESERVATION NEVER RELEASED: %d guards still pending %v after the settle window; e.g. %s", pending, settle, lastDetail)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
	}
}

// raceJoins：每个玩家同时向 p.a、p.b 入会（apply=true 时改为两个盟主同时批准），重发到确定答复。返回两边都成功的人数。
func (s *suite) raceJoins(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, p pair, players []int64, approveBy map[int64]int64, kill func()) (both, one, none int) {
	t := s.t
	type result struct{ a, b error }
	results := make([]result, len(players))
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	gate := make(chan struct{})
	for i, player := range players {
		for side, alliance := range []int64{p.a, p.b} {
			i, player, side, alliance := i, player, side, alliance
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				<-gate
				request := fmt.Sprintf("race-%d-%d", player, alliance)
				err, _ := definite(s.ctx, 3*time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
					var err error
					if approveBy != nil {
						_, err = client.Approve(ctx, request, approveBy[alliance], 1000, target(t, alliance), player)
					} else {
						_, err = client.Join(ctx, request, player, 1000, target(t, alliance))
					}
					return err
				})
				if side == 0 {
					results[i].a = err
				} else {
					results[i].b = err
				}
			}()
		}
	}
	close(gate)
	if kill != nil {
		kill()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for i, r := range results {
		okA, okB := r.a == nil, r.b == nil
		for _, err := range []error{r.a, r.b} {
			if err != nil && servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRejected {
				t.Fatalf("player %d: no definite answer: %v", players[i], err)
			}
		}
		switch {
		case okA && okB:
			both++
		case okA || okB:
			one++
		default:
			none++
		}
	}
	return both, one, none
}

func TestAllianceE2EOneAllianceUnderRace(t *testing.T) {
	s := newSuite(t, 20*time.Minute)
	opts := procOptions{keys: [][3]string{{"alliance", "reservation_ttl", "5s"}}}
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, opts)
	b := s.start("alliance-3001", "alliance", 3001, opts)
	client := s.client(nil, 3*time.Second)
	leader := int64(600_000)
	const n = 24
	players := func(base int64) []int64 {
		out := make([]int64, n)
		for i := range out {
			out[i] = base + int64(i)
		}
		return out
	}
	// 守卫先建在 3000：入 3000 上的联盟再退出（rejoin_cooldown 0s）。
	guardOnA := func(ids []int64, p pair) {
		for _, player := range ids {
			for _, step := range []func(ctx context.Context) error{
				func(ctx context.Context) error {
					_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("pre-join-%d", player), player, 1000, target(t, p.a))
					return err
				},
				func(ctx context.Context) error {
					_, err := client.Leave(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("pre-leave-%d", player), player, 1000, target(t, p.a))
					return err
				},
			} {
				if err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, step); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("player %d: %v", player, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	settle := 90 * time.Second

	// ① 守卫还不存在：两个实例并发新建守卫，原子认领只留一个，输的一方改走两步。
	p1 := s.foundPair(client, &leader, true)
	ids := players(700_000)
	both, one, none := s.raceJoins(client, p1, ids, nil, nil)
	sizes := s.checkOneAlliance(client, []int64{p1.a, p1.b}, ids, settle)
	t.Logf("RACE fresh guards: both=%d one=%d none=%d sizes=%v", both, one, none, sizes)
	if both != 0 || one != n {
		t.Fatalf("fresh guards: %d players got both joins, %d one, %d none; want exactly one each", both, one, none)
	}

	// ② 守卫在 3000：入 3000 的联盟走同实例事务，入 3001 的走两步（预约 → 加成员 → effect 确认）。
	p2 := s.foundPair(client, &leader, true)
	ids = players(710_000)
	guardOnA(ids, p2)
	both, one, none = s.raceJoins(client, p2, ids, nil, nil)
	sizes = s.checkOneAlliance(client, []int64{p2.a, p2.b}, ids, settle)
	t.Logf("RACE guards on 3000: both=%d one=%d none=%d sizes=%v", both, one, none, sizes)
	if both != 0 || one != n {
		t.Fatalf("guards on 3000: both=%d one=%d none=%d; want exactly one each", both, one, none)
	}

	// ③ 两个不开放的联盟各收到申请，两位盟主并发批准同一个玩家。
	p3 := s.foundPair(client, &leader, false)
	leaders := map[int64]int64{}
	for _, id := range []int64{p3.a, p3.b} {
		info, err := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, id))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		leaders[id] = info.Alliance.LeaderID
	}
	ids = players(720_000)
	for _, player := range ids {
		for _, id := range []int64{p3.a, p3.b} {
			if err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
				_, err := client.Apply(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("apply-%d-%d", player, id), player, 1000, target(t, id))
				return err
			}); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("apply %d to %d: %v", player, id, err)
			}
		}
	}
	both, one, none = s.raceJoins(client, p3, ids, leaders, nil)
	sizes = s.checkOneAlliance(client, []int64{p3.a, p3.b}, ids, settle)
	t.Logf("RACE approvals: both=%d one=%d none=%d sizes=%v", both, one, none, sizes)
	if both != 0 || one != n {
		t.Fatalf("approvals: both=%d one=%d none=%d; want exactly one each", both, one, none)
	}

	// ④ kill -9 守卫方（3000）：两步进行中守卫所在实例崩溃，同 sid 拉起后按期限与重发收尾。
	p4 := s.foundPair(client, &leader, true)
	ids = players(730_000)
	guardOnA(ids, p4)
	both, one, none = s.raceJoins(client, p4, ids, nil, func() {
		time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
		s.stop(a, syscall.SIGKILL)
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
		s.launch(a)
		s.waitReady(a, 2*time.Minute)
	})
	sizes = s.checkOneAlliance(client, []int64{p4.a, p4.b}, ids, settle)
	t.Logf("RACE kill -9 guard side: both=%d one=%d none=%d sizes=%v", both, one, none, sizes)
	if both != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("kill -9 guard side: %d players were told both joins succeeded", both)
	}

	// ⑤ kill -9 联盟方（3001）：两步里加成员的一方崩溃。
	p5 := s.foundPair(client, &leader, true)
	ids = players(740_000)
	guardOnA(ids, p5)
	both, one, none = s.raceJoins(client, p5, ids, nil, func() {
		time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
		s.stop(b, syscall.SIGKILL)
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
		s.launch(b)
		s.waitReady(b, 2*time.Minute)
	})
	sizes = s.checkOneAlliance(client, []int64{p5.a, p5.b}, ids, settle)
	t.Logf("RACE kill -9 alliance side: both=%d one=%d none=%d sizes=%v", both, one, none, sizes)
	if both != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("kill -9 alliance side: %d players were told both joins succeeded", both)
	}
}
